what: Zholdas (Жолдас, 'fellow traveller' in Kazakh), the mascot of zhol: a handmade plush toy in a trucker cap and a safety vest. Every file, its Higgsfield job and exact prompt.

identity.keep_in_every_pose: cream plush body, tiny black dot eyes, pink cheeks, mitten hands without fingers, brick-red felt trucker cap with a cream front panel, sage-green safety vest with two cream reflective stripes and a brass zipper, sand suede boots; no helmet, no text or logos

processing: trimmed transparent margins, fitted bottom-aligned into a 560x448 (5:4) canvas; WebP q80, alpha q90; 560 (2x) and 280 (1x)

poses.name: truck
poses.prompt: The exact same handmade plush toy character as in the reference images (Zholdas): almost smooth cream cotton body with fine fibers and a few loose seam threads, rounded-square face, tiny embroidered black dot eyes, small pink cheeks, quiet proud smile, round mitten hands without fingers, soft brick-red felt trucker cap with a cream front panel and a short curved brim, sage-green felt safety vest with two horizontal cream reflective stripes and a tiny brass zipper pull, small sand suede boots. Full figure standing next to a small toy European truck with a plain cream box trailer, the truck about as tall as him, one mitten hand resting on the cab, calm and proud. Soft daylight studio light, gentle contact shadow, isolated on a transparent background. No helmet, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no license plates, no other characters.
